name: Wilson Bank Holding Company
summary: Founded in 1987 and based in Lebanon, Tennessee, Wilson Bank Holding Company operates as the parent entity for Wilson Bank and Trust, providing a full spectrum of financial services to individuals, professionals, and small businesses throughout Tennessee. Its offerings include a variety of deposit accounts such as checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. Customers can also access a broad array of loan products, including those for homes, home equity, mortgages, land, construction, bridges, vehicles, personal needs, and businesses, along with credit and debit cards. The company extends its services to include custodial and trust solutions, comprehensive wealth management encompassing asset and portfolio management, and strategic planning for estates, finances, retirement, education, and businesses, complemented by investment options like stocks, bonds, and mutual funds. Additionally, it offers personal and business insurance, alongside convenient digital banking features such as e-statements, mobile deposit, sweep and payroll services, and online, mobile, and telephone banking.
